Coram : Sachin S. Deshmukh, J.
 Date : 25-02-2026

Per Court:-
1.

The applicant seeks regular bail in connection with Crime No.0184 of 2024 dated 29.05.2024 registered with Murud Police Station, District Latur, for the offences punishable under Sections 376(3), 363, 366 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The learned counsel submits that after filing chargesheet, the applicant has moved application for regular bail on medical grounds.

The learned Additional Sessions Judge, Latur, directed the Jail authorities to get the medical examination of the applicant and, thereafter, ascertain the status of the treatment and the period required for the treatment to the any higher center like J. J. Hospital,
Mumbai for definitive surgical management in respect of ventricular septal defect with pulmonary stenosis.
This Court, vide order dated 07.01.2026, called the report about the status of medical treatment of the applicant.
The medical report is issued by the concerned Medical Officer, Byculla District Prison.
4. The medical report indicates that the applicant was suffering from Tetrology of Fallot.

After many investigations, the applicant was admitted in J.J. Hospital on 12.12.2025 and cardiac surgery was Rushikesh Bhagwan Narwade vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 25 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148151854/
1 done to repair above ailment and was discharged on 04.02.2026.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant was again sent to the said Hospital on 06.02.2026 for follow up and was also being treated for raised liver parameters.
The medical diet in form of milk and eggs advised, currently the health of applicant is stable.
As such, the post surgical care and medical diet is recommended by the Doctor.
5. Considering the medical issue and on humanitarian grounds, a case is made out to exercise discretion in favour of the applicant and deserves to be released on temporary bail for four weeks.

6. Applicant, Rushikesh Bhagwan Narwade, be released on temporary bail for the period of four weeks from the date of his release, upon furnishing P.R. bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs.Fifty Thousand) with one or two local solvent sureties, in the like amount, in connection with the said crime for the foresaid offences, on the following conditions that;
3 917-BA-2271-25.odt (a) The applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses and tamper with the prosecution evidence, in any manner.

(b) The applicant shall submit Aadhar and Pan Cards to the Investigating Officer and detailed address and phone numbers and two of the near relatives.
(c) In case of breach of any of the conditions by the applicant, it is open for the Prosecution to move this Court seeking cancellation of bail.
7. The applicant shall surrender before the concerned Jail authorities after the period of four weeks from the date of his release.
8. Accordingly, list this application for further consideration on 08.04.2026.
